Joint PSNR 27.4-28.4 and CI 7-8/10 (<30 dB threshold) with structured residual dominated by JPEG quantization phase and blur-severity ambiguity -> overall UNCERTAIN, not POOR (degradation presence is strongly evidenced, subtype family clear, severity within +/-1).

cross_pair_systematic_residual.interpretation: A constant ~0.91 gain contraction of luma std and chroma that no allowed discrete global function can represent: the mildest contrast_weaken_scale:1 gives var factor 0.598 (0.486/0.813) and contrast_weaken_stretch:1 gives 0.351, while saturate_weaken_HSV:1 (S*0.7) was already measured harmful in R0 (24.97 dB). PSNR probes of both untested contrast families confirm the overshoot (27.28 / 22.03 dB). Best explanation: continuous-parameter/OOD effect of the challenge pipeline (e.g. JPEG quality between q8 and q5) that the integer grid cannot express. The grid optimum therefore stays at gaussian:4 + jpeg:4.

decision.rationale: No R1 candidate met the deterministic improvement bar (pair0 >2 dB or >35 dB with other pairs not notably worse). The control reproduces R0 exactly on all 5 supports; the two untested global families and the motion boundary probe all degrade pair0 by 1.1-6.3 dB; noise is definitively explained by the deterministic pipeline (sigma reproduced exactly on pairs 0/1/2); the pair2 saturation flag and pair1 strengthen flag are matched by opposite/absent flags on identical deterministic sims -> content-driven false positives. The remaining systematic ~0.91 luma/chroma contraction is a continuous-parameter/OOD effect not representable by any allowed function at any severity. R1 keeps R0 pipeline unchanged; gaussian:3+jpeg:4 remains the near-tie alternative (MTF/slope fingerprint), lens:4+jpeg:4 the cross-family backup.
